texts.preamble: Mohd Ikrar And 02 Others vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2020 Author: Piyush Agrawal Bench: Piyush Agrawal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ? In Chamber Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12370 of 2020 Applicant :- Mohd Ikrar And 02 Others Opposite Party :- State of U.P. Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Dwivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Piyush Agrawal,J. This bail application has been taken up during lock-down period as an urgent one.
texts.facts: This bail application has been taken up during lock-down period as an urgent one. The applicants are seeking bail in connection with Case Crime No. 20 of 2020, under Section 3/5/8 of Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act, P.S. Musanagar, Distt. Kanpur Nagar. The allegations made in the F.I.R. is that on 11.2.2020, on the information received from the informer, when the police intercepted the vehicle (J.S.A.) No. UP 77 T 0915, then it was found that the applicants were carrying beef in 03 plastic bags 100 Kg. each (total 300 Kg.) which was being transported on the said vehicle. After being arrested, the applicants admitted that they were carrying the beef for selling in the nearby village in respect of their livelihood. Mohd Ikrar And 02 Others vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57871400/ 1 It has been pleaded in the affidavit filed in support of the bail application that the applicants has been falsely implicated in the present case. One of the applicant namely Mustkeem is having Licence No. 22719427000061 issued under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 on 7.8.2019 for a period of one year in respect of running the meat shop. The entire prosecution story is false and fabricated as there is no independent witness to prove the alleged recovery. It is further pleaded that the applicants are in jail since 12.2.2020.
